Generative UI for conversational agents.

Combining @aisdk with Chat SDK and 𝚓𝚜𝚘𝚗-𝚛𝚎𝚗𝚍𝚎𝚛, you can go straight from LLM to UI on platforms like Slack and Teams.

https://t.co/MHxtLyoy7t https://t.co/tRgxRi5Hey

I unironically agree with @bcherny’s take that “coding is solved, but bugs are not.”

The deeper meaning is that you can in theory code *anything* now. You can burn infinite tokens refining and optimizing. Including optimizations that no one will care about 💀 

With Vercel you can build a different kind of recursive improvement loop. You capture traces from production, you then optimize and course-correct based on how your software is being used IRL.

This is not a new idea. The best engineers I’ve ever worked with never jumped into coding (now prompting) right away. You instrument the system, collect data, understand distributions, user journeys, and then put fingers on keyboard.

You can ask your agent today to look at your traces!

tweets.text:
美国 10 月非农就业数据远超预期，美联储 12 月加息押注进一步升温。

10 月新增非农就业人数 16.5 万，远超市场预期的 6.5 万；失业率降至 4.1%，低于预期的 4.2%。

数据公布后，美国短期利率期货走低，市场对美联储 12 月加息 25 个基点的押注升至约 80%，此前约为 75%。

就业市场越强，美联储就越没有降息的理由。

这对美股和加密市场都不是好消息：高利率预期升温，意味着流动性宽松可能还要继续等待。

据 @bitget 数据，11 月 2 日至 6 日，用户一周最关注的 5 只股票出炉：

Apple、Microsoft 双双创下历史新高，Nvidia、SK 海力士、Intel 却集体回调。

背后的逻辑是：市场正在重新给 AI 产业链定价。

Apple 受益于产品需求和业绩预期，股价再创新高；Microsoft 则凭借 Azure 云业务增长和 AI 商业化能力获得市场认可。

但 AI 硬件端没那么乐观：市场开始担忧 AI 基建投入的回报周期、数据中心建设限制及芯片供应链的不确定性。Nvidia、SK 海力士和 Intel 均受到不同程度冲击。

同样是 AI，有人享受算力红利，有人却开始为 AI 的高昂成本买单。

市场正在从「AI 概念普涨」，转向重新审视谁能真正从 AI 投资中赚钱。

让美股 AI 概念股崩盘的女议员，到底什么来头？

她叫 Yassamin Ansari @RepYassAnsari ，34 岁，民主党籍联邦众议员，伊朗移民后代，也是美国国会首位伊朗裔民主党女性议员。毕业于斯坦福大学和剑桥大学，曾在联合国工作，担任过凤凰城市议员、副市长，2025 年进入美国国会。

但真正让科技行业关注她的，是她对 AI 的态度。

今年 9 月，她就参与联署 Bernie Sanders 和 Greg Casar 推动的《禁止人工超级智能法案》。

法案提出：

- 暂停训练计算量达到 10²⁵ 次运算的先进 AI 系统。
- 在联邦监管机构建立安全规则前，限制相关系统部署。
- 永久禁止超级人工智能。

这已经不是简单的要求科技公司加强安全测试，而是试图从研发阶段限制 AI 的发展边界。

当然，她并不能一个人决定美国 AI 政策。民主党内部对暂停研发的范围、期限和永久禁令仍存在分歧，法案还需要经过国会审议，并面对特朗普可能的否决。

但市场真正担心的，或许不是 Ansari 一个人，而是她所代表的政治信号：

美国 AI 产业过去最大的风险是技术竞争，现在可能还要加上一项：监管突然踩刹车。

当美国一边试图在 AI 竞赛中领先中国，一边又有人主张暂停本土先进 AI 研发，英伟达、AMD、微软、谷歌以及整个数据中心产业，都不得不重新计算政策风险。

这场 AI 竞赛，开始出现一个新问题：美国究竟是要继续加速，还是先给自己的 AI 踩刹车？

tweets.text:
TLA+ has been incredibly useful, even on brownfield project, for turning implicit state machines into explicit specs where the entire flow can be tested and verified.

There is a deep relationship between user journey, UX flow and formal specification that has an enormous amount of value to slop code.

I wanted something more programmer-y and Typescript-y, and I came across Quint. It's highly agent friendly and seems to be maximally useful for this new paradigm of programming.

https://t.co/Tj1K7ZnrU7

Quint is high level, like TLA+, and doesn't formalize Typescript functionality. So underneath that, lower level, is Lemmascript.

https://t.co/iNBPVfkeSM

This lets you markup your Typescript with contracts.

The combination of these two things makes Typescript feel more like a compile time checked language, more verifiable, stronger guarantees, and it finds different kinds of bugs than AI generated unit tests seem to.

It's not a magic bullet but damn it does seem to improve code quality a lot.

And the agents can rapidly iterate against it.

I think we're gonna see a lot more of this kind of thing popping up, especially in interpreted languages like TS and Python.

I'd recommend using Quint when you're just modeling your application and flows (although I've been installing it into an existing project with good results) and then telling your agent to add Lemmascript in the build phase.
Now the real work begins
Good alpha https://t.co/EkuMXBpXwG

Yesterday the S&P 500 fell 4.36%, its worst day since 2011 outside of Covid and the April 2025 tariff shock. 

Options positioning sheds light on what exactly made this such a sharp drop: entering Thursday, dealers held negative gamma to the downside. This meant they hedged their positions by selling as prices fell, and every leg lower forced more selling.

As it stands, much of that negative gamma remains tied to the Nov 20 options expiration, so big swings in either direction remain a risk.
